g.text: S2 mid-gallop: weight on her left leg, right knee lifted,
both hands clapping two coconut halves at chest height, grin.
S4 seated: leaning 12 deg forward, cans ON, eyes-side, one hand
on the console faders, the other holds a celery stalk like a pencil.
S5 walking right: duffel on her back, boom pole on her shoulder,
free hand waving, head turned back at us (happy), mid-stride.
